title: Japan's Onamae Desktop Cloud hacked, up to 27,000 servers affected
description: The Onamae Desktop Cloud, a VPS service provider in Japan, suffered a security breach where attackers compromised its infrastructure and installed malware on up to 26,739 customer servers. This incident impacts a significant number of virtual private servers hosted by the provider. No specific technical details or remediation status are provided in the available information.
aiSummary: Hackers successfully breached the infrastructure of Onamae Desktop Cloud, a Japanese VPS service provider, and deployed malware on as many as 26,739 customer servers. The breach affected the provider's backend systems, enabling widespread malware infection across customer environments. No further technical details or exploit methods have been disclosed.
aiImpact: Up to 26,739 customer servers were infected with malware due to the compromise of the Onamae Desktop Cloud infrastructure. This likely results in unauthorized access, potential data loss, service disruption, and further malware propagation risks for affected customers. The scale of the breach indicates a significant impact on the provider's customer base.
